title: %base64urlEncode - URL-safe Base64 without padding
purpose: Encode a UTF-8 string as URL-safe Base64 (- and _ instead of + and /, no = padding).
notes: The output uses the URL-safe alphabet and drops trailing = padding, so it is safe in query strings and path segments.

avoid.why: %base64Encode yields standard Base64 with +, / and = padding, which is not URL-safe
